description: Run a full AEO audit of a URL covering FIND, READ, and USE. Async: returns an audit_id to poll with get_audit. Accepts an optional target_keyword. Spends one audit credit per fresh run; a same-URL re-run within 24h reuses the cached audit, uncharged.

target_keyword.description: Optional keyword to evaluate against; inferred when absent.

name: run_audit

audit_id.description: The audit id to poll with get_audit.

cached.description: Whether an existing recent audit was reused (uncharged).

eta_ms.description: Estimated time to completion in ms (0 when cached).

served_from_cache.description: Present + true on a cache hit.

status.description: 'queued' for a fresh run, 'complete' for a cache hit.

suggested_next_calls.description: Advisory next-tool-call pointers (suggested_next_calls). Score-neutral agent UX.

reason.description: Why this is the natural next step.

title: Run Full AEO Audit
